action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that DokuWiki did not properly encode the call parameter
of AJAX requests. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to
perform a reflected file download attack and trick a user into running
arbitrary programs.
isummary: DokuWiki could be used to trick users into running malicious programs.
